async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Scroll to the bottom of the homepage to ensure all content is loaded
    await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for any lazy-loaded content

    # Step 2: Look for pagination to navigate to page 3
    # First, try to find a navigation element that might contain pagination
    pagination = page.get_by_role('navigation').filter(has_text='Page')
    if await pagination.count() > 0:
        # If pagination exists, look for a link to page 3 within it
        page3_link = pagination.get_by_role('link', name='3')
        if await page3_link.count() > 0:
            await page3_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            return
    
    # If no pagination navigation found, check all links for page 3 indicators in href
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    for i in range(link_count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if href and ('page=3' in href or 'paged=3' in href or '/page/3' in href):
            await link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            return

    # If still not found, as a last resort, check for any link with text '3' but exclude monthly archive links
    # Use filter to avoid links in the complementary section (which have '' in name)
    possible_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='3').filter(has_not_text='')
    if await possible_links.count() > 0:
        await possible_links.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        # If no page 3 found, output a message as required
        print('Could not find page 3 of the blog feed after scrolling.')
